arms.full: Full selected S01_L08; archived live Full reference, plus paired live Full if new API contract is used
arms.no_anchor: Remove pretrained Anchor network, replace protected and competing positions using native trust-region proposals, disable temperature variants, retain frozen Full cases and all other modules
arms.no_online_generators: Remove all six online generation operators and native extra proposal, preserve Anchor, online proxy, Residual and Agent, disclose frozen Full case support may not match ablated candidate set
arms.no_agent: Remove entire Agent including LLM, retrieval, feedback and extra proposal; retain Anchor, online generators, online proxy and Residual

paired: Preserve initial population and objective RNG boundaries per function and trajectory; compare Full and independent baseline
real_api: Live configured LLM for Full and two LLM ablation arms; no-agent has no LLM calls; record failures and actual executed decisions
api_contract_caveat: R15 API original contract versus R18 repaired user-message contract differs; do not compare as if identical. Paired fresh Full must use same request contract as ablations; disclose reference differences.
completion: All trajectories and actual valid API executed decisions independently verified; no fabricated or pilot-only results

execution.frozen_R15_cases_reused: Each ablation retains Full cases and support gates; those cases were not retrained for ablations.
execution.api_contract: R18 repaired user-message contract for all live arms
execution.fail_fast: Stop if at least 100 completed API requests and less than 20 percent have at least one validated action; preserve failed and pending records.
execution.postrun: Validate raw trajectories and real API responses, summarize category and per-function comparisons; require valid executed API responses for every 35 x 3 live arm pair.
